manufacturer.name: Novoferm
manufacturer.note: German door and operator manufacturer, with national arms on their own domains (novoferm.pl, novoferm.co.uk) that publish separately from the group site. The Tormatic brand appears on some of its operator documentation. Four documentation indexes across the group are registered as harvest targets; aggregator listings report 93+ Novoferm manuals, so what is here is a small fraction of the range.
